summary.text: Charlie Foote is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Army veteran whose career experience includes work as a firefighter and in emergency medical services.

paragraphs.text: Charlie Foote lives in New Hampshire, served in the U.S. Army, and has worked as a firefighter and in EMS, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2022, and its campaign contribution history shows general-election wins in Rockingham 13 in 2022 and 2024.
He was assigned to the House Transportation Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
